mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_info (item_id, creator_id, item_type, title, summary, visibility, status, create_time, publish_time, update_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{creatorId}, #{itemType}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{visibility}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE item_info SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
UPDATE item_info SET status = #{status}, publish_time = NOW(3), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, creator_id, item_type, title, summary, visibility, status, create_time, publish_time, update_time FROM item_info WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT item_id, creator_id, item_type, title, summary, visibility, status, create_time, publish_time, update_time FROM item_info WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
